name: Play! Pokémon Prize Pack Series Six

releases.name: Play! Pokémon Prize Pack Series Six

description.text:
Play! Pokémon Prize Packs are six-card packs that Pokémon sends to Play! Pokémon stores to hand out at in-store events such as Leagues, League Challenges and League Cups; stores with more active events get more packs. Every card is a reprint that keeps its original set number and is marked with the Play! Pokémon logo.

Series Six, released on 14 February 2025, holds 94 cards from Obsidian Flames through Stellar Crown, plus SVE basic Energy. Its foil cards are cosmos holo, except Pokémon ex and ACE SPEC cards, which keep their usual foil.
